root_causes.description: llm.py pre-flight ctx routing sorts non-ollama providers before ollama providers when chain cooldown is active. Since kimi_k2_6_cloud is type=ollama and codex is type=codex_cli, codex moves to position 0 and kimi to position 3 during reorder.
root_causes.confirmed_by: probe chain comparison and code audit

root_causes.description: Total request budget (90s) is consumed by first providers in the reordered chain. By the time loop reaches kimi at position 3, remaining budget is less than min_provider_budget (8s), so kimi is skipped entirely.

When kimi fails by timeout or empty response, the loop advances to next provider. There is no retry logic for the same provider, so a transient Kimi failure permanently loses the provider for that request.
root_causes.confirmed_by: llm.py loop iterates each provider once

root_causes.description: Kimi timeout is 75s. Combined with reorder and budget sharing, this means a single provider failure can consume the entire request budget.

_chain_in_cooldown forces reorder for ALL queries on the chain, not just slow ones. This degrades the provider chain globally after failures, causing even fast-query probes to hit the reordered chain.
